title: Agentic Harness — Phase Manifest
description: Per-feature phase metadata authored by the plan and read by the orchestrator at dispatch time. Introduced in Phase 10 per codex v4 fix: `feature-list.json` is feature-grained and cannot carry one unambiguous model suggestion per phase when a feature spans multiple phases or a phase satisfies multiple features. The phase manifest is therefore the sole carrier of the `suggested_model` field and any other phase-granular metadata the orchestrator consumes (dependencies, touched-files, etc.). Lives at `dev/<feature>/phase-manifest.json`. Orchestrator-owned per D-10 (sub-agents never write to it).

schema_note.description: Free-form note about authoring conventions or feature-specific caveats. Not load-bearing; orchestrator ignores it.

features.description: List of feature-list entry ids this manifest covers. Mirrors the `id` values in `feature-list.json` so the orchestrator can cross-check that every feature maps to at least one phase and every phase's `suggested_model` is backed by a real feature. Duplicates not permitted.

phases.description: Ordered list of phase entries. Order reflects planned execution; the orchestrator still evaluates the DAG declared via `dependencies` at dispatch time.

id.description: Stable phase identifier. Format: phase-N. Must match the `blocking_phase` values used in feature-list.json.

title.description: Human-readable phase title. Pulled from the plan §4 phase heading.

suggested_model.description: Plan author's suggested implementation-agent model for this phase. `codex` selects the Codex CLI backend rather than the Agent tool. The orchestrator treats this as a suggestion and validates it against the 5-rule decision flow in `.claude/commands/agentic-dev.md` §'Model Selection Heuristics' at dispatch time. Default when omitted from a plan is `sonnet` (per Phase 10 rule 1); this schema requires it be written explicitly so the plan's intent is auditable.

dependencies.description: Phase ids this phase depends on. Feeds the DAG used by Phase 9's parallel-safety check. Empty array means the phase can run first. Cycles are a plan bug; orchestrator refuses to dispatch on detection.

touched_files.description: Repo-root-relative paths the phase is expected to write. Feeds Phase 9's C-1 disjoint-files check and the per-phase branch's touched-files audit. Globs (e.g. `src/foo/*.cs`) are allowed; orchestrator expands them at dispatch.

subsystems.description: Logical subsystems touched (e.g. 'runtime', 'tests', 'docs', 'skill'). Feeds the 'cross-cutting if >= 2 subsystems' heuristic in §'Model Selection Heuristics' rule 2. Optional.

correctness_critical.description: True when the phase modifies a determinism pin, hasher, or is explicitly flagged by the plan as an INTENTIONAL HASH CHANGE. Triggers opus promotion per §'Model Selection Heuristics' rule 2.

foundational.description: True when the phase establishes contracts later phases depend on (e.g. an interface first used in phase-N and read by phases >N). Triggers opus promotion per §'Model Selection Heuristics' rule 2.

suggested_model_rationale.description: Optional one-line justification for the plan's `suggested_model` choice. Not load-bearing; the orchestrator records its own rationale via `state.json.current_phases[i].model_choice_rationale` regardless.
